title: Is There a Phone in Your Hand Right Now? 📱
caption:
Look at your hand. Is there a phone in it?

Screens feel like a break, but they're the opposite. Stanford's Jeremy Bailenson explained why video calls drain you, and every scroll is a tiny surprise your brain keeps chasing.

Which level of tired are you on right now? 👇
